papers.title: Teaching Vision-Language Models to Use the Scale They Are Given: Label-Free Equivariance Training for Metric Physical Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 教视觉语言模型使用给定的尺度：用于度量物理推理的无标签等变训练
papers.reason: 该研究关注视觉语言模型在物理度量推理中的尺度不变性问题，并提出利用物理对称性进行无标签监督训练。这与多模态数据融合和地理空间智能中对视觉模型可靠性的关注高度相关，其方法对遥感变化检测中的物理量度估计具有借鉴意义。
papers.abstract: Metric questions about video require vision-language models to use supplied real-world references to convert visual measurements into physical units. Yet we find that current models use this scale information only partially. When every world-space quantity in a prompt is rescaled by a common factor, the video remains equally valid and the correct answer changes by exactly that factor, but model predictions move only part of the way and accuracy remains concentrated near the familiar scale of the depicted objects. Across eight vision-language models, this under-response persists over four orders of magnitude. The same models recover the correct closed-form scaling laws when the identical physics is asked in a scale-free form, indicating that the main deficit lies in metric grounding rather than physical mechanism knowledge. We use this exact scaling relation as supervision without requiring metric annotations. Under a common rescaling of the supplied world-space quantities, the correct metric answer must change by the same factor. EquiSD exploits this constraint by projecting a model's own prediction onto the scale-equivariant family and fine-tuning the model on the resulting targets. It requires no ground-truth answers and only one model query per training video. On held-out simulated videos, EquiSD increases a 3B model's median response slope from 0.66 to 0.94 and improves mean relative accuracy by 9.2 points across scales. The learned relation generalizes to unseen world scales and transfers without adaptation to real QuantiPhy videos, where accuracy increases by 6.4 points. These results show that an exact physical symmetry can provide label-free supervision for improving metric grounding in vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh: 论文发现视觉语言模型在处理视频中的度量问题时，未能充分利用提供的真实世界尺度信息。当所有世界空间量按共同因子缩放时，模型预测仅部分响应。作者提出EquiSD方法，利用这种精确的缩放关系作为监督信号，无需度量标注，仅需一次模型查询即可微调模型。在模拟视频上，该方法将3B模型的中位响应斜率从0.66提升至0.94，平均相对准确率提升9.2个百分点，并泛化至未见尺度和真实视频。
papers.insight_zh: 视觉语言模型在度量物理推理上的缺陷主要在于度量锚定而非物理机制知识，利用物理对称性作为无标签监督信号是提升模型度量能力的一种有效且通用的策略。

papers.title: MCSeg: Pre-training and Fine-tuning Volumetric Pyramid Transformer for Multi-modal Cardiac Image Segmentation
papers.title_zh: MCSeg：用于多模态心脏图像分割的体素金字塔Transformer预训练与微调
papers.reason: 研究聚焦于多模态心脏图像分割，提出新型特征金字塔结构连接ViT与CNN解码器，并采用自监督预训练，与遥感变化检测中的多模态融合和特征提取方法有共通之处。
papers.abstract: Automatic cardiac image segmentation is pivotal for diagnosing and treating cardiac diseases. In this work, we introduce MCSeg, a volumetric transformer-based network tailored for multi-modal cardiac segmentation. To overcome the architectural mismatch inherent in existing hybrid networks, we propose a novel Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP). Unlike conventional skip connections, the SFP effectively bridges the single-scale 3D Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder and the multi-scale CNN decoder by transforming the ViT's output into a hierarchical feature pyramid, ensuring that global contextual information is effectively leveraged. For the training paradigm, the ViT encoder first undergoes self-supervised pre-training via masked image modeling. Subsequently, the network is fine-tuned on downstream tasks, during which a regional mutual information (RMI) loss is integrated to improve boundary segmentation accuracy. In experiments, MCSeg consistently outperforms eleven SOTA methods on CT dataset ImageCHD, multi-modal dataset MM-WHS, MRI dataset HVSMR-2.0 and MSD Heart, highlighting the effectiveness of our MCSeg for multi-modal cardiac segmentation tasks. Furthermore, MCSeg's superior performance in few-shot experiment showcases its significant potential in adapting to limited data scenarios. Codes and pre-trained ViT-B weights are open-sourced at https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/OpenMedIA/MCSeg
papers.summary_zh: 介绍MCSeg，一种基于体素Transformer的多模态心脏分割网络。通过提出的缩放特征金字塔（SFP）桥接单尺度3D ViT编码器和多尺度CNN解码器，并采用掩码图像建模进行自监督预训练，结合区域互信息损失进行微调。在多个数据集上优于11种SOTA方法，并在少样本场景中表现优异。
papers.insight_zh: 通过设计有效的特征金字塔结构，可以解决混合架构中编码器与解码器尺度不匹配的问题，从而更充分地利用全局上下文信息，提升多模态分割性能。

papers.title: Aligned Radiometric RGB-Thermal Fusion for UAV Facade Anomaly Screening
papers.title_zh: 面向无人机立面异常筛查的对齐辐射测量RGB-热红外融合
papers.reason: 该论文研究无人机RGB-热红外融合用于建筑立面异常筛查，涉及多源数据融合、遥感平台与建筑检测，与研究者关注的多源数据融合、遥感变化检测和城市更新（建筑立面筛查）高度相关。
papers.abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle facade inspection can combine red, green, and blue (RGB) imagery with thermal measurements to screen surface and subsurface anomalies. However, geometric discrepancies between the sensors and thermal image rendering can obscure spatial correspondence and weak temperature contrasts. This article presents a sensor-level pipeline comprising per-sensor correction, RGB-to-thermal registration, common-support cropping, and signed local contrast encoding of 16-bit radiometric measurements. The encoding preserves the distinction between locally hotter and colder regions and supplies the fourth input channel of a compact single-stream detector. We introduce M3T, a dataset of 674 paired RGB and radiometric thermal samples from five facade-inspection projects covering eight component and anomaly categories. The median residual registration error is 3.384 pixels, and a controlled-displacement analysis characterizes how the local contrast response changes under controlled displacement. Project-grouped four-fold evaluation yields mean average precision of 0.168 over intersection-over-union thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95, using 28.50 billion floating-point operations per image. A separate single-split ablation shows improved delamination detection over RGB-only and alternative thermal inputs, although aggregate accuracy does not improve over RGB alone. Evaluation on RGBT-Tiny shows mixed performance with rendered thermal imagery. These results characterize the category-specific benefits and limitations of aligned radiometric contrast for compact facade screening.
papers.summary_zh: 无人机立面巡检可将红绿蓝（RGB）影像与热测量结合，以筛查表面和次表面异常。然而，传感器间的几何差异和热图像渲染可能模糊空间对应关系并削弱温度对比。本文提出一个传感器级流程，包括逐传感器校正、RGB到热红外配准、共同支撑裁剪以及16位辐射测量的带符号局部对比编码。该编码保留局部更热与更冷区域的区别，并为紧凑单流检测器提供第四输入通道。作者引入M3T数据集，包含来自五个立面巡检项目的674对RGB与辐射热样本，覆盖八个部件与异常类别。中位残差配准误差为3.384像素，受控位移分析刻画了局部对比响应在受控位移下的变化。按项目分组的四折评估在0.5至0.95的交并比阈值上平均精度为0.168，每张图像使用28.50亿次浮点运算。单独的单划分消融显示，相比仅RGB和其他热输入，分层剥离检测有所改善，但总体精度未超过仅RGB。在RGBT-Tiny上的评估使用渲染热图像时表现参差。这些结果刻画了对齐辐射对比用于紧凑立面筛查的类别特定收益与局限。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作将辐射测量热数据与RGB在传感器级对齐并编码为检测器输入通道，为城市建筑立面异常筛查提供了多源融合流程；其配准误差与类别特定收益的分析提示，多源融合在城市更新检测中需关注几何对齐与任务适配，而非简单叠加。

papers.title: Population-level measures of perceived food access reveal barriers beyond geographic proximity
papers.title_zh: 人口层面的感知食品可达性测量揭示地理邻近性之外的障碍
papers.reason: 该研究利用Google Maps评论测量感知食品可达性，涉及城市分析、多源数据融合和时空数据挖掘，与城市更新和地理空间智能研究高度相关。
papers.abstract: Food access is multidimensional, but population-level measurement still relies heavily on geography because perceived dimensions of access are difficult to measure at scale. Here, we use 25,125 Google Maps reviews from 49 grocery stores in Raleigh, North Carolina, to measure five dimensions of food access: availability, accessibility, affordability, accommodation, and acceptability. We identify review topics with unsupervised topic modeling and assign them to access dimensions using zero-shot classification, with 85.4% agreement against manual coding. The resulting store-level measures capture distinct aspects of food access and reveal barriers that geographic proximity alone does not capture. Comparisons between nearby stores in the same chain further show that identical store policies can be perceived very differently across locations, consistent with food access reflecting the fit between residents and their food environment. Perceived food access also follows systematic socioeconomic and demographic patterns that broadly parallel, but do not replicate, those observed for geographic access. These results show that online grocery reviews can provide a scalable complement to geographic measures of food access.
papers.summary_zh: 食品可达性是多维的，但人口层面的测量仍然严重依赖地理因素，因为可达性的感知维度难以大规模测量。在这里，我们使用北卡罗来纳州罗利市49家杂货店的25,125条Google Maps评论来测量食品可达性的五个维度：可用性、可及性、可负担性、适应性和可接受性。我们通过无监督主题建模识别评论主题，并使用零样本分类将其分配到可达性维度，与人工编码的一致率为85.4%。由此得到的店铺层面测量捕获了食品可达性的不同方面，并揭示了仅靠地理邻近性无法捕获的障碍。对同一连锁店附近店铺的比较进一步表明，相同的店铺政策在不同地点可能被感知得非常不同，这与食品可达性反映居民与其食品环境之间契合度的观点一致。感知食品可达性还遵循系统性的社会经济和人口模式，这些模式与地理可达性观察到的模式大致平行，但并不完全复制。这些结果表明，在线杂货评论可以为食品可达性的地理测量提供可扩展的补充。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究展示了如何利用在线评论和NLP方法补充传统地理可达性测量，其多源数据融合和感知维度分析思路可迁移至城市更新中的公共服务设施评估，但论文未涉及城市更新或变化检测。

papers.title: CoSkill: Joint Reinforcement Learning of Reasoning and Meta-Skill Agents for Hierarchical Skill Evolution
papers.title_zh: CoSkill：推理与元技能智能体的联合强化学习用于层次化技能进化
papers.reason: 论文提出CoSkill，一个统一的多智能体强化学习框架，联合训练推理智能体和元技能智能体，实现层次化技能库的协同进化。这与GIS博士研究方向中的LLM和多智能体高度相关，其层次化技能学习和智能体协作机制可应用于城市更新中的复杂决策任务。
papers.abstract: Skill libraries improve the sample efficiency of agentic reinforcement learning (RL) by enabling large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge. Yet existing paradigms exhibit structural shortcomings: they either decouple skill evolution from policy optimization or instantiate meta-skills as fixed workflows. Both treat skills as passive objects to be managed, limiting the flexible evolution of skills and their co-adaptation with the reasoning agent. To address the limitations, we propose CoSkill, a unified multi-agent RL framework that recasts the static meta-skill workflow as a learnable Meta-Skill Agent and jointly trains it with a Reasoning Agent over a hierarchical skill library. By modeling the Reasoning and Meta-Skill Agents as a cooperative team sharing a single backbone, CoSkill enables end-to-end co-adaptation: the Reasoning Agent conditions its actions on a retrieved task skill and step skills selected from its child set, while its task performance guides the Meta-Skill Agent in refining those step skills. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that CoSkill substantially outperforms prior skill-based and RL baselines, achieving success rates of 98.4% and 90.6%, respectively (+3.5 and +6.2 pp). As shown in Figure 1, CoSkill achieves superior early-stage sample efficiency, asymptotic performance, and wall-clock efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/jinyuan-cookie/CoSkill.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出CoSkill，一个统一的多智能体强化学习框架，将静态的元技能工作流重塑为可学习的元技能智能体，并与推理智能体在层次化技能库上联合训练。通过将推理和元技能智能体建模为共享单一主干的合作团队，CoSkill实现了端到端的协同适应：推理智能体根据检索到的任务技能和从其子集中选择的步骤技能来调节其行动，而其任务表现则指导元技能智能体优化这些步骤技能。在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验表明，CoSkill的成功率分别达到98.4%和90.6%，显著优于先前的技能基和RL基线。
papers.insight_zh: 将技能库中的元技能视为可学习的智能体，并与推理智能体联合训练，可以实现技能和推理策略的协同进化，提升样本效率和最终性能。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Time Series Prediction via Mixture of Modulated Experts
papers.title_zh: 基于调制专家混合的多模态时间序列预测
papers.reason: 多模态时间序列预测与多源数据融合高度相关，可用于整合遥感、社交媒体和传感器数据，支持城市动态监测与更新评估。
papers.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种多模态时间序列预测方法，采用调制专家混合机制，动态组合不同模态的专家模型以提升预测性能。
papers.insight_zh: 在城市更新中，融合多源异构数据（如卫星影像、POI、移动信令）进行时间序列预测，可更全面地捕捉城市变化信号。

papers.title: Estimating Pedestrian Volumes from GIS-Derived Built-Environment Features: A Machine Learning Framework
papers.title_zh: 基于GIS衍生建成环境特征的行人流量估计：一个机器学习框架
papers.reason: 该研究直接使用开放GIS数据中的建成环境、土地利用和街道网络特征，通过机器学习预测城市交叉口行人流量，与城市更新、时空数据挖掘及地理空间智能方向高度相关，但未涉及LLM、多智能体或遥感变化检测。
papers.abstract: Transportation agencies need pedestrian volume estimates across entire road networks to prioritize safety investments, yet manual counts are expensive and cover only a small share of intersections. We present a machine learning pipeline that predicts 2-hour PM peak pedestrian volume at 101 urban intersections in Portland, Oregon, from built-environment, land-use, and street-network features drawn from open GIS data. Starting from the Negative Binomial GLM used in practice, we add feature selection, count-aware gradient boosting, and repeated cross-validation, selecting one configuration by a combined rank over RMSE, MAPE, and SMAPE across four cross-validation strategies. The winner, a histogram-based gradient boosting model with Poisson loss and L1 Lasso feature selection, reduces cross-validated RMSE by 12% over the GLM baseline (89.8 to 78.7) and holdout RMSE by 19% (108.0 to 87.9). Code is released on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh: 交通机构需要覆盖整个路网的行人流量估计以优先安排安全投资，但人工计数成本高昂且仅覆盖少量交叉口。本文提出一个机器学习流程，利用开放GIS数据中的建成环境、土地利用和街道网络特征，预测美国俄勒冈州波特兰市101个城市交叉口的2小时晚高峰行人流量。研究从实践中使用的负二项GLM出发，加入特征选择、计数感知梯度提升和重复交叉验证，并根据RMSE、MAPE和SMAPE在四种交叉验证策略下的综合排名选择一种配置。获胜模型为采用Poisson损失和L1 Lasso特征选择的直方图梯度提升模型，将交叉验证RMSE较GLM基线降低12%（89.8降至78.7），留出集RMSE降低19%（108.0降至87.9）。代码已在GitHub发布。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作表明，开放GIS衍生的建成环境特征结合计数感知的梯度提升方法，可在有限人工计数条件下提升全路网行人流量估计精度；其建模思路可迁移至城市更新场景中的人流活动监测，但摘要未涉及时空动态、LLM或多智能体方法。

papers.title: Space as an Interventional Invariant: Cross-Modal Predictive Geometry for Stratified Cities and Em-Spaced Intelligence
papers.title_zh: 空间作为干预不变性：分层城市与Em-Spaced智能的跨模态预测几何
papers.reason: 该文将空间定义为干预不变性，提出跨模态预测几何框架，并扩展到分层城市系统，与城市更新、多源数据融合和地理空间智能的研究方向高度相关。
papers.abstract: Space is a foundational concept across mathematics, physics, spatial cognition, urban science, and embodied intelligence, yet these fields often treat spatial structure either as a shared geometric container or as a collection of disconnected representations. Such approaches struggle to explain how heterogeneous sensory and urban processes can jointly reveal a common spatial structure, particularly when different modalities do not share the same metric or representation. This paper addresses this gap by defining space as an interventional invariant: the minimal relational structure that preserves local compatibility and the conditional laws of future observations under admissible actions. We develop a cross-modal predictive geometry that integrates local state spaces, modality-specific observation maps, an action groupoid, and a canonical predictive-state quotient, with explicit causal conditions for identifying interventional rather than merely observational structure. The key theoretical result shows that, under joint point separation, equivariance, and interventional faithfulness, the latent space is identifiable up to the centraliser of the intervention group, thereby reducing representational ambiguity to residual coordinate freedom. The framework is further extended to stratified urban systems using sheaf-valued representations, allowing geometric, physical, mobility, social, and economic layers to coexist without being reduced to a single metric. Synthetic experiments under noise evaluate equivariance, predictive sufficiency, holonomy, restriction-map recovery, cross-scale consistency, and context saturation. The resulting framework provides a unified and falsifiable foundation for spatial cognition, urban science, embodied AI, and em-spaced intelligence.
papers.summary_zh: 空间是数学、物理、空间认知、城市科学和具身智能中的基础概念，但这些领域常将空间结构视为共享的几何容器或互不相关的表示集合。本文通过将空间定义为干预不变性来弥补这一空白：即在可允许动作下保持局部兼容性和未来观测条件律的最小关系结构。作者发展了跨模态预测几何，整合局部状态空间、模态特定观测映射、动作群胚和规范预测状态商，并给出识别干预结构而非仅观测结构的显式因果条件。核心理论结果表明，在联合点分离、等变性和干预忠实性下，潜在空间可在干预群的中心化子意义下被识别，从而将表示歧义降低为残余坐标自由度。该框架进一步通过层论表示扩展到分层城市系统，使几何、物理、移动性、社会和经济层能够共存而不被归约为单一度量。合成噪声实验评估了等变性、预测充分性、和乐、限制映射恢复、跨尺度一致性和上下文饱和。
papers.insight_zh: 该框架为城市多源数据融合提供了统一且可证伪的理论基础，可能推动城市更新中多模态时空数据的联合表示学习，但其实际城市应用效果尚需实证检验。

papers.title: NS-Copilot: An LLM-Driven Agent System for Autonomous Neuroscience Analysis
papers.title_zh: NS-Copilot：用于自主神经科学分析的LLM驱动智能体系统
papers.reason: 该研究展示了LLM驱动的多智能体系统如何协调多个专业预训练模型以完成端到端的科学分析工作流。其系统架构和智能体协作模式对构建地理空间智能体系统，整合不同遥感或城市数据模型具有重要的方法论参考价值。
papers.abstract: AI is rapidly advancing neuroscience, yet many laboratories fail to fully unleash its potential due to significant interdisciplinary barriers. While pre-trained neural models for physiological data are progressing quickly, their heterogeneous architectures and modality-specific constraints hinder systematic integration, selection, and evaluation. Despite recent advances in large language model (LLM)-based agent systems for intelligent scientific applications, existing approaches often still lack the domain expertise required to effectively select and coordinate diverse neuroscience pre-trained models and handle unique data types in this domain. We present NS-Copilot, an LLM-driven multi-agent system for neuroscience analysis that autonomously supports end-to-end workflows for diverse professional tasks. It unifies domain-specific pre-trained models and supports key neuroscience modalities, including EEG and extracellular spike data, through a natural-language interface. Given raw data and a task description, NS-Copilot orchestrates agents with specialized roles for planning, adaptive control, code generation, and result synthesis, enabling analysis without dataset-specific heuristics. We evaluate NS-Copilot on neuroscience benchmarks spanning Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and working memory spike decoding. Across 8 trials per task, the system consistently outperforms strong baselines on the primary metric, demonstrating the ability of NS-Copilot for effective and scalable neuroscience analysis.
papers.summary_zh: 本文介绍NS-Copilot，一个LLM驱动的多智能体系统，用于神经科学数据分析。该系统通过自然语言接口统一了领域特定的预训练模型，并支持EEG和细胞外尖峰数据等模态。NS-Copilot通过编排具有规划、自适应控制、代码生成和结果合成等专门角色的智能体，实现了无需数据集特定启发式方法的端到端分析流程。在多个神经科学基准测试中，其性能优于强基线。
papers.insight_zh: LLM驱动的多智能体系统能够有效协调异构的领域专用模型，通过角色分工和自然语言交互，实现复杂科学数据的自动化端到端分析，降低了跨学科应用门槛。

papers.title: When Ground-Truth Fidelity Matters: An Orchestrated UAS Framework for Wheat Streak Mosaic Virus Detection Using Vision Transformers and Machine Learning
papers.reason: 关键词命中：Geospatial、Deep Learning、Transformer
papers.abstract: Wheat streak mosaic virus (WSMV) is a destructive pathogen of sweet corn and other cereal crops, causing yield losses and complicating early detection because symptoms are spatially variable and subtle. In sweet corn seed production, WSMV also has regulatory importance, as phytosanitary regulations from countries such as New Zealand and Chile require seed lots to be certified virus-free. Visual scouting is unreliable because symptoms can resemble abiotic stress, while enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) is accurate but expensive, labor-intensive, and difficult to scale. We present an automated pipeline for plant-level WSMV detection using unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) multispectral imagery. The framework integrates orthomosaic reconstruction, geospatial alignment, plant extraction, and classification using a Vision Transformer with seven-channel inputs (five spectral bands, NDVI, and NDRE). Using treatment-based labels, the model achieved 89% accuracy on over 6,500 test patches across multiple growth stages. However, ELISA-based ground truth revealed substantial label noise: only a small fraction of sampled plants in inoculated plots were infected. Treatment labels therefore did not reliably represent infection status, and the high accuracy was largely driven by label bias rather than disease detection. Performance decreased markedly against row-level symptom severity and plant-level ELISA labels. Under these higher-fidelity but smaller-sample conditions, both deep learning and classical machine learning showed limited generalization and weak separability between ELISA-confirmed mock-inoculated and infected plants. These results show that UAS-based disease detection is constrained by label fidelity and data availability, emphasizing biologically grounded labels and models aligned with real-world conditions.

papers.title: Catalogue Photography as a Cold Start: Toward Deployable Rotary Milling Tool Recognition
papers.title_zh: 目录摄影作为冷启动：迈向可部署的硬质合金毛刺识别
papers.reason: 论文研究从目录图像到实地图像的领域迁移问题，与用户研究中遥感变化检测和多源数据融合的领域泛化问题相关，其量化领域差距和探索简单迁移增益的方法具有参考价值。
papers.abstract: Verifying that manufactured batches of milling tools or carbide rotary burrs conform to production order sheets remains a largely manual and error-prone quality assurance task. Automating this process with computer vision faces a critical cold-start constraint since no labelled imagery is available, leaving manufacturer catalogue photography as the sole source of supervision. We investigate how far catalogue supervision can support an industrial recognition pipeline under domain shift, explicitly measuring the gap between catalogue separability and performance on held-out field photographs. Our findings reveal three key insights. First, off-the-shelf frozen feature extractors do not reliably separate the two task attributes, head shape and tooth profile, motivating targeted representation learning. Second, metric learning produces near-perfect unsupervised cluster discovery on catalogue images (adjusted Rand index 0.94--0.97), but less than half of this gain transfers to field photographs. Third, the largest transfer gains do not come from model scale or representation complexity, but from simple changes that reduce domain sensitivity: converting images to grayscale (+0.22) and constraining retrieval using the known order sheet via Hungarian assignment (+0.11). We therefore treat catalogue photography as a useful cold start rather than a deployment-ready training domain, and provide empirical baselines and an evaluation protocol for catalogue-to-field transfer in precision tool manufacturing.
papers.summary_zh: 论文探讨了在无标注图像情况下，利用制造商目录摄影作为唯一监督来源，构建工业识别流程的可能性。研究发现现成的冻结特征提取器无法可靠分离任务属性，度量学习在目录图像上表现优异但迁移到实地图像时增益不足一半，而简单的灰度转换和基于订单表的匈牙利匹配约束能带来最大的迁移增益。
papers.insight_zh: 目录摄影可作为有用的冷启动，但并非可直接部署的训练域；降低领域敏感性的简单改动（如灰度化、利用已知订单表约束检索）比增加模型规模或表示复杂度更能有效提升迁移性能。

papers.title: RA-SOD: Reliability-Aware RGB-T Salient Object Detection under Modality Degradation
papers.title_zh: RA-SOD：模态退化下的可靠性感知RGB-T显著性目标检测
papers.reason: 该论文研究RGB-热红外多模态融合中的模态可靠性建模与不确定性引导融合，与多源数据融合和遥感变化检测方向有较强的方法论关联，但任务本身是显著性目标检测而非地理空间变化检测，因此相关性中等。
papers.abstract: RGB-Thermal (RGB-T) salient object detection leverages complementary cues from visible and thermal modalities to improve robustness in challenging environments. However, in real-world scenarios, the reliability of each modality is inherently unstable: RGB images degrade under low illumination, motion blur, and noise, while thermal imagery often suffers from contrast compression and sensor artifacts. Such degradation introduces unreliable perceptual evidence that can mislead cross-modal fusion and significantly deteriorate detection performance. To address this challenge, we propose RA-SOD, a reliability-aware RGB-T salient object detection framework that explicitly models modality reliability and integrates it into feature learning and cross-modal fusion. First, we introduce a reliability-conditioned representation that adaptively compensates degraded modality features while preserving structural cues. Second, an uncertainty-guided dual-stream refinement strategy progressively corrects cross-modal representations while suppressing unreliable evidence. Finally, we propose a pixel-wise modality competition mechanism that dynamically selects modality cues according to spatial reliability for fine-grained fusion. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks (VT821, VT1000, VT5000, and VT-IMAG) demonstrate that RA-SOD achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibits strong robustness under severe modality degradation. Code and models are available at https://github.com/zaoxienian/RA-SOD.
papers.summary_zh: RGB-热红外（RGB-T）显著性目标检测利用可见光和热红外模态的互补线索，提升在复杂环境中的鲁棒性。然而在真实场景中，各模态的可靠性本质上并不稳定：RGB图像在低照度、运动模糊和噪声下退化，热红外图像则常受对比度压缩和传感器伪影影响。此类退化引入不可靠的感知证据，可能误导跨模态融合并显著降低检测性能。为应对该挑战，作者提出RA-SOD，一个可靠性感知的RGB-T显著性目标检测框架，显式建模模态可靠性并将其融入特征学习与跨模态融合。首先引入可靠性条件化表示，自适应补偿退化模态特征并保留结构线索；其次采用不确定性引导的双流细化策略，逐步校正跨模态表示并抑制不可靠证据；最后提出逐像素模态竞争机制，依据空间可靠性动态选择模态线索以实现细粒度融合。在VT821、VT1000、VT5000和VT-IMAG四个基准上的大量实验表明，RA-SOD达到当前最优性能，并在严重模态退化下表现出强鲁棒性。代码与模型已开源。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作对模态可靠性的显式建模与不确定性引导融合思路，可迁移至多源地理空间数据融合（如光学与SAR、多时相遥感）中处理模态质量不稳定的问题；但其验证限于显著性检测基准，尚未证明在地理空间变化检测任务上的有效性。

papers.title: GUIDE: Generative Utility Inference and Decision Engine
papers.title_zh: GUIDE：生成式效用推断与决策引擎
papers.reason: 该论文提出LLM驱动的偏好推断与决策架构，结合贝叶斯自适应采样和符号表示学习，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Measuring the preferences of human users remains a fundamental challenge of AI alignment. Existing elicitation approaches struggle to efficiently discover multidimensional preferences or accurately ground these inferences in domain knowledge. To address this, we introduce GUIDE, an LLM-driven elicitation architecture that infers user preferences through conversations by combining Bayesian adaptive sampling for question selection and symbolic representation learning to initialize domain-specific preference models. GUIDE generalizes adaptive sampling to diverse elicitation questions through an extensible type system of transforms on a parameterized preference state. GUIDE produces domain-specific preference representations through an initialization process using symbolic rule-based learning to capture world knowledge and set priors over preference dimensions grounded in data about decision alternatives. The architecture provides observability and steerability to facilitate deployment and analyze elicitation processes. In silico experiments on investment portfolio optimization demonstrate that GUIDE improves cold-start and minimizes recommendation regret consistently within early elicitation interactions across user personas compared to prior work, LLM-only baselines, and ablated GUIDE versions.
papers.summary_zh: 衡量人类用户的偏好仍然是AI对齐的一个基本挑战。现有的 elicitation 方法难以高效发现多维偏好，也难以将这些推断准确地建立在领域知识之上。为解决这一问题，我们提出GUIDE，一种LLM驱动的 elicitation 架构，通过对话推断用户偏好，结合用于问题选择的贝叶斯自适应采样和用于初始化领域特定偏好模型的符号表示学习。GUIDE通过一个可扩展的变换类型系统，将自适应采样推广到多样化的 elicitation 问题，这些变换作用于参数化偏好状态。GUIDE通过使用基于符号规则学习的初始化过程生成领域特定偏好表示，以捕获世界知识，并基于关于决策备选方案的数据在偏好维度上设定先验。该架构提供可观测性和可操控性，以促进部署和分析 elicitation 过程。在投资组合优化上的计算机实验表明，与先前工作、仅LLM基线和消融版GUIDE相比，GUIDE在早期 elicitation 交互中持续改善了冷启动并最小化了推荐遗憾。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作展示了LLM结合贝叶斯采样和符号学习进行偏好推断的通用框架，其可扩展类型系统和可观测性设计可能为地理空间决策中的用户偏好建模提供方法借鉴，但论文本身未涉及地理空间数据或城市应用。

papers.title: Code-to-Harness: Distilling Black-Box Optimizers from Self-Play
papers.title_zh: 自动构建Harness：代码中的自博弈为黑盒优化蒸馏出文本Harness
papers.reason: 该文研究LLM智能体通过可执行实践学习数值搜索策略并蒸馏为文本提示，属于LLM与智能体方法研究，与研究中“LLM和多智能体”方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Can an agent learn a numerical search strategy through executable practice and then transfer that strategy as text? We study low-budget black-box optimization, where unaided language models remain well below strong classical optimizers. During development, an agent repeatedly writes and evaluates optimizer programs. It then distills the resulting program and practice record once into a 197-word primary Harness A, which is frozen before evaluation. Harness A reduces Gemini Flash regret by 48\% in an independent $N=30$ study ($p<.001$), enters the GP-BO performance range on the practice family, and lowers mean regret on all three held-out BBOB landscapes. The same text improves every tested Gemini executor and transfers to Claude Sonnet, reducing regret by 43\% and 49\% ($p\leq.005$). An independent end-to-end replication produces Harness B, a different program and text at the same performance tier. The same framework also attains the lowest regret on a sealed YouTube reward-tuning production benchmark. Executable practice is thus a viable way to discover a search policy, and language a portable medium for deploying it.
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究智能体能否通过可执行实践学习数值搜索策略，并将该策略以文本形式迁移。作者关注低预算黑盒优化场景，在此场景中，未经辅助的语言模型仍明显弱于强经典优化器。在开发过程中，智能体反复编写并评估优化器程序，随后将所得程序与实践记录一次性蒸馏为197词的主Harness A，并在评估前冻结。Harness A在独立N=30研究中将Gemini Flash的regret降低48%（p<.001），在实践族上进入GP-BO性能区间，并在三个留出BBOB地形上降低平均regret。同一文本改善了所有受测Gemini执行器，并迁移至Claude Sonnet，分别将regret降低43%和49%（p≤.005）。独立端到端复现产生了Harness B，即同一性能层级下不同的程序与文本。该框架还在一个封存的YouTube奖励调优生产基准上取得最低regret。因此，可执行实践是发现搜索策略的可行方式，而语言是部署该策略的可移植媒介。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示，智能体可通过“写程序—评估—蒸馏为文本”的闭环获得可迁移的搜索策略；对时空数据挖掘而言，或可借鉴其将优化经验文本化并跨模型迁移的思路，但文中未涉及地理空间任务。

papers.title: Exposing Weaknesses in Emotion Recognition in Conversations
papers.title_zh: 揭示对话情感识别中的弱点
papers.reason: 该研究探讨了对话情感识别中单标签假设的局限性，并引入LLM-as-Judge框架，对GIS中涉及文本或社交媒体数据的情感与意图分析具有方法论启示。
papers.abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) aims to identify speakers' emotions in multi-turn dialogue. Accurate emotion recognition can support a wide range of applications, including empathetic conversational agents, mental health support, and educational technologies. While many recent approaches rely on task-specific fine-tuning, such models may exploit dataset-specific cues. A central yet rarely questioned assumption in ERC is that each utterance can be assigned a single unambiguous emotion label. To investigate this assumption, we study ERC using Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting while incorporating preceding conversational turns as context. We show that aggregate metrics mask systematic failures. Errors concentrate around utterances containing negations, exclamations, and interjections. This pattern is consistent across all evaluated models, suggesting limitations in the benchmarks rather than model-specific weaknesses. A controlled re-annotation study involving four human annotators supports this finding: strong agreement is observed in only 35 percent of cases, with neutral utterances dominating high-agreement instances, while many emotional categories fall into low-agreement regimes. These findings suggest that many apparent model errors reflect genuine annotation ambiguity rather than poor emotion understanding. Standard single-label evaluation is therefore insufficient. To address this limitation, we introduce an LLM-as-Judge framework that evaluates each emotion independently according to its plausibility in the conversational context rather than enforcing a single-label decision.
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究使用LLM在零样本设置下进行对话情感识别（ERC），发现聚合指标掩盖了系统性失败，错误集中在包含否定、感叹和感叹词的语句中。受控重新标注研究表明，四位标注者仅在35%的情况下达成强一致，且中性话语主导高一致实例，许多情感类别处于低一致区域。这表明许多模型错误反映的是真实的标注歧义而非理解能力差。为此，引入LLM-as-Judge框架，根据情感在对话语境中的合理性独立评估每种情感。
papers.insight_zh: 标准单标签评估不足以衡量ERC系统的真实性能，因为许多错误源于标注歧义；基于合理性的独立情感评估框架能更准确地反映模型能力。

papers.title: Earth-Agent-Pro: Towards Real-World Full-Chain Earth Observation with Agents
papers.reason: 关键词命中：Remote Sensing、Large Language Model
papers.abstract: Real-world Earth observation (EO) agents must translate high-level scientific questions into executable workflows to acquire observations, prepare data, perform domain computations, and derive conclusions from runtime evidence. Existing EO agents typically start from supplied observations, while benchmarks typically provide prepared inputs or candidate answers, leaving full-chain open-world EO execution largely untested. We present Earth-Agent-Pro, an execution-adaptive Plan-and-Execute framework using expert-authored skills to constrain planning and runtime tool use. Workflow-centered structured memory records planned steps, accepted evidence, and their dependencies, enabling repair of only the affected workflow suffix when runtime evidence invalidates a step. Separate large language model adapters use sequence-level supervised fine-tuning for planner workflow composition and node-level group relative policy optimization with locally verifiable rewards for executor tool-argument grounding. Earth-Bench-Pro instantiates 248 expert-curated task cores as 744 questions under three matched regimes. Its 248 Open-World Execution questions span RGB imagery, spectral observations, and remote sensing products, pairing high-level requests with runtime data requirements, executable trajectories, and open-ended answers grounded in execution evidence. With a shared GPT-5 backbone, Earth-Agent-Pro achieves 66.13% LLM-as-Judge accuracy, exceeding ReAct by 20.95 points in this metric and 24.44 points in Tools-In-Order. Joint adapter tuning raises Qwen3.5-9B LLM-as-Judge accuracy from 38.31% to 50.00%, an 11.69-point gain over the untuned configuration. Planning-only evaluation and execution with the reference workflow show that the adapters improve workflow composition and argument grounding, respectively. Code and datasets will be released soon.

papers.title: TDDM-Melatt: A Decoupled Memory and Diffusion Framework for Generalizable Encrypted Traffic Classification
papers.title_zh: TDDM-Melatt：用于可泛化加密流量分类的解耦记忆与扩散框架
papers.reason: 该研究提出一种解耦记忆和扩散框架用于加密流量分类，解决泛化性问题，其方法（如解耦表示学习、扩散数据增强）对博士研究中多源数据融合和模型泛化性提升具有方法论上的参考价值。
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of encrypted traffic poses severe challenges to current security situational awareness systems based on network traffic monitoring. In existing dataset-driven training and testing studies, limitations such as shortcut learning induced by spurious feature correlations and sample imbalance caused by the long-tail distribution of real-world traffic result in weak generalization of traffic identification performance to real-world network traffic. To address these limitations, we propose TDDM-Melatt, a disentangled memory-based traffic classification framework with diffusion-based data augmentation. First, we design Melatt, a memory-decoupled traffic representation model, which employs Competitive Gating Long Short-Term Memory (CG-LSTM) to construct the encoder and decoder. We design a spurious-correlation-free pre-training and inference paradigm, employing strict topology anonymization and a frozen pre-trained encoder strategy to cut off the model's learning pathways for spurious features. During inference, classification is performed efficiently by a downstream classifier on the frozen representations. Second, we propose a Traffic Denoising Diffusion Model (TDDM) tailored to the characteristics of traffic data. Extensive experiments are conducted on 4 representative public benchmark datasets. Under strict flow-level splitting and anonymization, TDDM-Melatt outperforms 6 basic classification models and 6 SOTA representation learning models. The proposed method provides a new and effective technical pathway for encrypted traffic classification in real-world network environments.
papers.summary_zh: 提出TDDM-Melatt框架，包含一个基于记忆的解耦流量表示模型（Melatt），采用竞争门控LSTM和严格拓扑匿名化及冻结预训练编码器策略，以切断虚假特征学习。同时提出针对流量数据的去噪扩散模型（TDDM）进行数据增强。在4个基准数据集上，该方法优于6个基础分类模型和6个SOTA表示学习模型。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究表明，通过解耦表示学习和扩散模型增强，可以有效提升模型在数据分布变化下的泛化能力，这种思路可迁移到其他存在数据漂移和样本不均衡问题的领域。

papers.title_zh: 基于视觉语言模型的几何海岸线定位

papers.title: What Moves? Localized Motion Representations for Compositional Scene Control
papers.title_zh: 什么在动？用于组合场景控制的局部运动表示
papers.reason: 该论文提出一种可提示的局部运动表示方法，用于组合场景控制，涉及视频理解和生成，与时空数据挖掘和动态场景分析有一定的方法论关联。
papers.abstract: Real-world dynamics are inherently compositional: multiple entities move simultaneously within a shared scene, each exhibiting distinct motion patterns. Yet most existing video representations encode motion globally, without explicitly capturing localized motion for individual entities. Crucially, motion is defined relative to a global reference frame, including camera motion and scene layout. However, localized embeddings are often computed from cropped images or obtained by masking features after encoding, discarding the context needed to interpret motion. To address this, we introduce a promptable localized motion representation that produces persistent embeddings for user-specified regions defined by spatial masks. Rather than cropping the input or masking features, our model processes the full video and conditions motion encoding directly on the queried region. This yields temporally consistent, region-addressable embeddings that isolate local dynamics while retaining the global context required for disambiguation. We demonstrate object-level motion transfer, enabling controlled composition of dynamic scenes. Beyond generative control, our embeddings support localized action classification in multi-actor videos. Across both tasks, our approach improves controllability and outperforms global representations localized through cropping or post-hoc masking. Project Page: https://compvis.github.io/WhatMoves
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出了一种可提示的局部运动表示，为空间掩码定义的用户指定区域生成持久嵌入。模型处理整个视频，并直接根据查询区域调节运动编码，而非裁剪输入或掩码特征。这产生了时间一致、可寻址区域的嵌入，在保留全局上下文的同时隔离了局部动态。该方法在物体级运动转移和局部动作分类任务上均优于通过裁剪或事后掩码的全局表示。
papers.insight_zh: 在保留全局上下文的同时显式编码局部区域运动，能有效提升动态场景的可控性和理解能力，这对视频监控或城市动态分析中的多目标跟踪与行为识别具有参考价值。

papers.title: TestDG: Test-time Domain Generalization for Continual Test-time Adaptation
papers.title_zh: TestDG：面向持续测试时适应的测试时域泛化
papers.reason: 该论文研究持续测试时适应的测试时域泛化，属于域适应与泛化方向。遥感变化检测常面临域偏移问题，该工作的方法论对多源数据融合和变化检测中的域适应有潜在借鉴意义。
papers.summary_zh: 摘要内容为空，无法提供具体摘要。根据标题推测，该工作提出TestDG方法，用于在持续测试时适应场景下实现测试时域泛化。
papers.insight_zh: 摘要缺失，无法判断其具体方法。从标题看，该工作可能提升模型在动态域偏移下的泛化能力，对遥感变化检测中的跨域问题有潜在参考价值。

papers.title: TileNet: Tile-Based CNN-SVM Architecture for Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Systems Inspection of Flat Roofs
papers.title_zh: TileNet：面向平屋顶自主无人机系统巡检的基于瓦片的CNN-SVM架构
papers.reason: 该论文使用无人机影像和轻量CNN-SVM进行平屋顶缺陷检测，涉及遥感影像分析、建筑物维护与可持续性，与遥感变化检测和城市更新有一定关联，但未涉及变化检测、多源融合或时空数据挖掘。
papers.abstract: Flat roofs are among the most influential components of the building envelope, governing both structural performance and thermal efficiency, and thereby contributing directly to household energy consumption, carbon emissions, and long-term environmental sustainability. Timely detection of roof defects is essential for reducing heating and cooling losses, preventing moisture-driven degradation such as mold growth, and supporting national climate-change mitigation goals. This paper presents a real-time, Unmanned Aerial System (UAS)-based deep learning framework that autonomously detects defects using live imagery captured during dual-altitude aerial passes. The multi-resolution flight strategy is designed to aid the identification of both small, fine-scale defects and larger structural issues, enabling more comprehensive assessments. To meet the strict computational and power constraints of embedded UAS hardware, the proposed framework integrates a tile-based architecture with a lightweight Convolution Neural Network-Support Vector Machine (CNN-SVM) classifier designed for low-latency onboard inference. The final model-comprising five convolutional layers and four dense layers, the last a linear SVM head, achieved a mean test accuracy of $94.4\%$ ($95\%$ confidence interval $\pm0.4\%$ over three seeds) on a photo-level split ($43,383$ training, $3,869$ validation, and $2,540$ test tiled and augmented images), outperforming GoogLeNet ($89.2\%$) and AlexNet ($79.8\%$). Experimental evaluations using real UAS imagery collected by onsite visits with DJI Matrice 350 RTK drone demonstrate that the system supports rapid, repeatable, and safe roof inspections while reducing human risk, lowering operational costs, and enabling more sustainable building maintenance.
papers.summary_zh: 平屋顶是建筑围护结构中影响最大的组成部分之一，决定结构性能和热效率，从而直接影响家庭能耗、碳排放和长期环境可持续性。及时检测屋顶缺陷对于减少供暖和制冷损失、防止霉菌生长等湿气驱动的退化，以及支持国家气候变化减缓目标至关重要。本文提出一个实时无人机系统（UAS）深度学习框架，利用双高度航空飞行中捕获的实时影像自主检测缺陷。多分辨率飞行策略旨在帮助识别小型精细缺陷和较大结构问题，从而实现更全面的评估。为满足嵌入式UAS硬件的严格计算和功耗限制，所提框架将基于瓦片的架构与轻量卷积神经网络-支持向量机（CNN-SVM）分类器集成，用于低延迟机载推理。最终模型包含五个卷积层和四个全连接层，最后一层为线性SVM头，在照片级划分（43,383张训练、3,869张验证和2,540张测试的瓦片化及增强图像）上取得平均测试准确率94.4%（三个随机种子下95%置信区间±0.4%），优于GoogLeNet（89.2%）和AlexNet（79.8%）。使用DJI Matrice 350 RTK无人机现场采集的真实UAS影像进行的实验评估表明，该系统支持快速、可重复且安全的屋顶巡检，同时降低人员风险、运营成本，并促进更可持续的建筑维护。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究展示了轻量CNN-SVM与瓦片化策略在无人机边缘端进行屋顶缺陷实时检测的可行性，其多分辨率飞行策略有助于兼顾小缺陷与大结构问题；该方法可服务于城市建筑维护与更新评估，但摘要未涉及变化检测或多源数据融合。

papers.title: A Large-Scale AIS Dataset from Finnish Water
papers.title_zh: 来自芬兰水域的大规模AIS数据集
papers.reason: 该文发布芬兰水域大规模AIS船舶轨迹数据集，属于时空轨迹数据资源，与时空数据挖掘和地理空间智能相关，但不涉及城市更新或遥感变化检测。
papers.abstract: This research paper contributes to the maritime research community by introducing a comprehensive AIS dataset from Finnish waters, specifically the Baltic Sea region. AIS data, initially designed for collision prevention, have evolved into a versatile tool with applications across diverse maritime domains. Our paper not only curates and categorises existing AIS datasets but also introduces a collected AIS dataset from the Baltic Sea area, renowned for its intercontinental cargo routes, military activities, and frozen water expanses. This dataset includes 229 millions data points and provides researchers with a resource for studying maritime activities and vessel behaviour in this dynamic region, notably distinguished by the inclusion of data from Finnish lakes. Our analysis includes a detailed listing of ship types and relevant features, empowering researchers to explore various maritime domains. To enhance comprehension and analysis, we provide visualisations of maritime traffic patterns. By publishing this AIS dataset, we aim to catalyse innovation and collaboration in maritime research, offering a gateway to deeper insights into maritime activities in the Baltic Sea and Finnish lakes.
papers.summary_zh: 本文通过引入一个来自芬兰水域（特别是波罗的海地区）的综合AIS数据集，为海事研究社区作出贡献。AIS数据最初用于防碰撞，现已发展为在多个海事领域具有广泛应用的多功能工具。本文不仅梳理并分类了现有AIS数据集，还引入了一个采集自波罗的海区域的AIS数据集，该区域以洲际货运航线、军事活动和冰封水域而闻名。该数据集包含2.29亿个数据点，为研究人员研究这一动态区域的海事活动与船舶行为提供了资源，其显著特点是纳入了芬兰湖泊的数据。分析包括对船舶类型和相关特征的详细列举，便于研究人员探索各类海事领域。为增强理解与分析，作者提供了海上交通模式的可视化。通过发布该AIS数据集，作者旨在推动海事研究的创新与协作，为深入洞察波罗的海和芬兰湖泊的海事活动提供入口。
papers.insight_zh: 该数据集可为船舶轨迹挖掘、时空模式发现与多源海事数据融合提供基础资源；其包含湖泊数据的特点可能支持内河与近海交通的对比研究，但摘要未说明数据的时间跨度、采样频率与清洗流程。

papers.title: Explaining Time Series Forecasting with Horizon-Resolved Attribution
papers.title_zh: 以预测步长解析的归因解释时间序列预测
papers.reason: 该研究提出面向预测步长的时序模型归因解释方法，属于时间序列可解释性研究，与时空数据挖掘中的时序预测与可解释性需求有较强方法关联。
papers.abstract: Recent advances in explaining time series (TS) models have produced methods that identify which past values a prediction depends on. However, most existing methods return a single importance vector, assuming that every predicted step depends on the same past values. In this paper, we show that this assumption does not hold, as different forecast steps depend on different past values. Motivated by this observation, we propose Horizon-Resolved eXplanation (HRX), which adds a horizon axis to the explanation, so that every forecast step receives its own importance map. HRX is a simple yet effective plug-in framework with three components: 1) an estimator that reads these maps out of any differentiable forecaster without modifying the TS backbone, 2) an evaluation protocol that validates the horizon axis by measuring how much a single forecast step changes when the inputs an importance map ranks highest are removed, and 3) a rank criterion that predicts in advance whether the axis is worth resolving on a given TS. We further show that this step-wise dependence is low-dimensional, as the explanations of all steps are built from a few shared maps whose number does not grow with the forecast length. Extensive experiments across various backbones and datasets show that the improvement comes from the horizon axis and holds for estimators of previous explanation methods. Code is available at https://github.com/seunghan96/HRX.
papers.summary_zh: 近期时间序列模型解释方法的进展产生了能够识别预测依赖哪些过去值的方法。然而，大多数现有方法返回单一重要性向量，假设每个预测步依赖相同的过去值。本文表明这一假设并不成立，因为不同预测步依赖不同的过去值。基于这一观察，作者提出预测步长解析解释，在解释中增加一个预测步长轴，使每个预测步获得自己的重要性图。HRX是一个简单而有效的即插即用框架，包含三个组件：1）一个估计器，可在不修改时间序列骨干网络的情况下从任意可微预测器中读出这些图；2）一个评估协议，通过测量当移除重要性图排名最高的输入时单个预测步的变化程度来验证预测步长轴；3）一个排序准则，可预先判断在给定时间序列上是否值得解析该轴。作者进一步表明这种逐步依赖是低维的，因为所有步的解释由少数共享图构成，其数量不随预测长度增长。在多种骨干网络和数据集上的大量实验表明，改进来自预测步长轴，并且对先前解释方法的估计器同样成立。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究揭示不同预测步依赖不同历史信息，且这种依赖具有低维共享结构；这一发现对城市时空预测（如交通流、人口动态）中按预测步长解析归因、提升模型可解释性具有直接方法借鉴意义。

papers.title: RoES: Rotational Equivariant Selective-frequency Fusion for Multimodal Images
papers.title_zh: RoES：面向多模态图像的旋转等变选择性频率融合
papers.reason: 该文研究红外-可见光多模态图像融合，属于多源数据融合与遥感相关方法范畴，与研究中多源数据融合、遥感变化检测方向有较强方法关联，但未涉及地理空间语义或城市应用。
papers.abstract: Infrared-visible image fusion facilitates robust multimodal perception by integrating complementary textural nuances from visible sensors with thermal signatures from infrared systems. Due to the task's inherently ill-posed nature, existing methods heavily rely on structural priors but typically enforce rotation equivariance uniformly across all features. Such a holistic approach overlooks a critical distinction where low-frequency shared structures strictly adhere to equivariant constraints while high-frequency modality-specific details require greater flexibility to preserve unique information. To bridge this gap, we propose RoES, a Rotational Equivariant Selective-frequency fusion network. Instead of employing static decomposition, we introduce a trainable rotation-enhanced updater/predictor module to dynamically decouple low- and high-frequency components. The resulting representations are then processed through a dual-branch fusion module tailored for spectral consistency. Specifically, a rotation-equivariant Mamba is employed to capture long-range structural dependencies in the low-frequency domain, while a polar spectral attention-based Dual-Fourier block refines high-frequency details under explicit low-frequency guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoES consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both fusion quality and downstream object detection, establishing a robust solution for multimodal fusion by reconciling frequency-selective features with equivariant constraints. The source code is available at https://github.com/BryceLosky/RoES-Fusion.
papers.summary_zh: 红外-可见光图像融合通过整合可见光传感器的纹理细节与红外系统的热特征，支持鲁棒的多模态感知。由于该任务本质上是病态的，现有方法严重依赖结构先验，但通常对所有特征统一施加旋转等变约束。这种整体化做法忽视了一个关键区别：低频共享结构严格遵循等变约束，而高频模态特有细节需要更大灵活性以保留独特信息。为弥补这一差距，本文提出RoES，一种旋转等变选择性频率融合网络。该网络不采用静态分解，而是引入可训练的旋转增强更新/预测模块，动态解耦低频与高频成分。所得表示随后通过为频谱一致性定制的双分支融合模块处理：旋转等变Mamba用于捕捉低频域的长程结构依赖，而基于极坐标谱注意力的双傅里叶块在显式低频引导下细化高频细节。大量实验表明，RoES在融合质量和下游目标检测上均持续达到最先进水平，通过协调频率选择特征与等变约束，为多模态融合提供了稳健方案。源码已公开。
papers.insight_zh: 该文的频率选择性等变融合思路，或可启发遥感多源影像（如光学与SAR/热红外）融合中的结构保持与细节增强，但其评测限于通用融合与检测基准，未涉及地理空间场景。

papers.title: ParaRecover: A Process-Level Benchmark for Error Localization and Recovery in Parallel Tool-Use Agents
papers.title_zh: ParaRecover：并行工具使用智能体中错误定位与恢复的过程级基准
papers.reason: 该文提出并行工具使用智能体的错误定位与恢复基准，直接涉及多智能体系统与LLM智能体评估，与LLM和多智能体研究方向高度相关，但不涉及地理空间应用。
papers.abstract: Existing agent benchmarks mainly evaluate final task success or tool-call correctness, providing limited insight into whether agents can reliably diagnose and recover from intermediate execution failures. This limitation becomes particularly critical in multi-turn parallel tool-use scenarios, where errors may propagate across dependent branches and trigger cascading failures. We introduce ParaRecover, a process-level benchmark for evaluating error localization and recovery in multi-turn parallel tool-use agents. Built upon a fine-grained taxonomy of 14 error types covering planning dependencies, tool selection, and argument matching, the benchmark comprises 10,626 instances spanning two difficulty levels. To enable finegrained, process-oriented evaluation, we further propose the SDE rubric, which measures structural integrity, diagnostic reasoning, and evolutionary strategy during agent execution.Experiments across more than ten mainstream LLMs reveal that even state-of-the-art models still struggle with multi-turn error propagation,implicit tool-use failures, and precise replanning. Moreover, we demonstrate that the SDE rubric provides effective supervision signals for improving agents' reflective recovery capabilities. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/gbw206/ParaRecover.
papers.summary_zh: 现有智能体基准主要评估最终任务成功或工具调用正确性，对智能体能否可靠诊断和恢复中间执行失败提供的洞察有限。这一局限在多轮并行工具使用场景中尤为关键，因为错误可能在依赖分支间传播并触发级联失败。作者提出ParaRecover，一个用于评估多轮并行工具使用智能体中错误定位与恢复的过程级基准。基于涵盖规划依赖、工具选择和参数匹配的14种错误类型的细粒度分类法，该基准包含10,626个实例，跨越两个难度级别。为实现细粒度、面向过程的评估，作者进一步提出SDE评分标准，衡量智能体执行过程中的结构完整性、诊断推理和演化策略。在十多个主流LLM上的实验表明，即使最先进的模型在多轮错误传播、隐式工具使用失败和精确重规划方面仍存在困难。此外，作者证明SDE评分标准为提升智能体的反思性恢复能力提供了有效的监督信号。数据和代码见https://github.com/gbw206/ParaRecover。
papers.insight_zh: 该基准为多智能体系统的鲁棒性评估提供了过程级视角，其错误分类法和评估框架可能对地理空间智能体工作流的可靠性研究有借鉴意义，但文中未涉及地理空间场景。

papers.title: AIM: A Privacy-Aware Interoperable Memory Framework for Multi-Agent Multi-User LLM Systems
papers.title_zh: AIM：面向多智能体多用户LLM系统的隐私感知互操作记忆框架
papers.reason: 该论文提出AIM，一个面向多智能体多用户LLM系统的隐私感知互操作记忆框架，直接涉及LLM和多智能体研究方向，与GIS博士研究中的LLM和多智能体方向高度相关，但不涉及地理空间数据或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Traditional large language models (LLMs) are scoped to individual user sessions, limiting their knowledge to a single conversation and preventing them from learning user preferences that evolve over time. Existing agentic memory systems address this limitation but generally operate at the individual-user level, restricting the public knowledge that could be shared across users to improve downstream responses. We introduce AIM (Agentic Interoperable Memory), a unified, privacy-aware memory framework that enables multi-agent, multi-user LLM systems to persistently manage private and shared memory. AIM dynamically classifies information as private, scoped to one user and inaccessible to others, or public, accessible to all users. It enforces index-level access controls so that private memories are retrievable only by their owner, protecting sensitive data while allowing beneficial shared knowledge to improve coordination and consistency. We also introduce MUMBench (Multi-User Memory Benchmark), a dataset of multi-user interactions containing private and shareable information across four domains. To our knowledge, MUMBench is the first public dataset designed to evaluate multiple memory operations, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion, in a multi-user environment. Across three independent runs on MUMBench, AIM achieves 96.0% visibility classification accuracy, 58.8% strict operation accuracy, and 70.5% state-aware operation accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出AIM（Agentic Interoperable Memory），一个统一的、隐私感知的记忆框架，使多智能体、多用户LLM系统能够持久管理私有和共享记忆。AIM动态地将信息分类为私有（限于单个用户且他人不可访问）或公共（所有用户可访问），并实施索引级访问控制，使私有记忆仅能由其所有者检索。作者还提出MUMBench（多用户记忆基准），一个包含四个领域私有和可共享信息的多用户交互数据集，据作者所知这是首个用于评估多用户环境中多种记忆操作（包括检索、创建、更新和删除）的公开数据集。在MUMBench上的三次独立运行中，AIM实现了96.0%的可见性分类准确率、58.8%的严格操作准确率和70.5%的状态感知操作准确率。
papers.insight_zh: 该框架通过索引级访问控制区分私有与共享记忆，为多智能体协作中的信息共享与隐私保护提供了机制设计，其多用户记忆操作基准也可为地理空间智能中多智能体协作场景的记忆管理评估提供参考，但论文未涉及地理空间应用。

papers.title: Local Edits, Global Ripples: Replay-Informed Policy Adaptation for Workflow Synthesis
papers.title_zh: 局部编辑，全局涟漪：用于工作流合成的回放知情策略适应
papers.reason: 该论文研究LLM智能体工作流合成中的策略编辑与适应，与LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Prompt-policy editing offers a practical way to improve agents that synthesize executable workflows without updating the underlying model. However, persistent prompt editing has two coupled properties. First, edit locality does not imply effect locality: an edit confined to one policy segment can ripple through downstream execution, altering behavior beyond the edited segment. Second, edit effects are composition-sensitive: edits that work in isolation can interfere after composition, causing one or both to lose their benefit or become harmful. Persistent adaptation must therefore support two distinct decisions: identifying where the policy should change from execution feedback, and determining whether the resulting edit remains safe to persist after composition. To address these challenges, we introduce RIPPLE (Replay-Informed Persistent Policy Localization and Editing), which separates where an edit is made from whether it remains safe after composition. It diagnoses failed trajectories, maps each actionable failure to a predefined policy segment, and restricts the correction to that part of the policy. RIPPLE then evaluates candidates against the same iteration-start policy to compare their isolated gains, before replaying promising edits after previously accepted updates to expose downstream effects and interactions. Only edits that remain safe under composition are retained. We evaluate RIPPLE on Flow-HO, a synthetic held-out benchmark for executable workflow synthesis. RIPPLE improves validation success by up to 23.1% and yields positive gains on two additional frozen language-model backbones, while maintaining edit efficiency and low execution cost. Targeted interaction analysis further demonstrates both properties: a segment-local tool-use edit changes downstream resource resolution and validation, while an edit beneficial in isolation becomes harmful after composition.
papers.summary_zh: 提示策略编辑为改进合成可执行工作流的智能体提供了一种实用方法，而无需更新底层模型。然而，持久性提示编辑具有两个耦合特性。首先，编辑局部性并不意味着效果局部性：局限于一个策略片段的编辑可能通过下游执行产生涟漪效应，改变被编辑片段之外的行为。其次，编辑效果对组合敏感：孤立有效的编辑在组合后可能相互干扰，导致其中一个或两个失去益处或变得有害。因此，持久性适应必须支持两个不同的决策：从执行反馈中识别策略应在何处改变，以及确定所得编辑在组合后是否仍然安全可持久化。为应对这些挑战，我们提出RIPPLE（回放知情持久策略定位与编辑），它将编辑位置与组合后是否安全分离。它诊断失败轨迹，将每个可操作的失败映射到预定义的策略片段，并将修正限制在策略的该部分。RIPPLE然后针对同一迭代起始策略评估候选编辑，以比较其孤立增益，再在先前接受的更新之后回放有前景的编辑，以暴露下游效果和交互。只有组合后仍然安全的编辑才会被保留。我们在Flow-HO上评估RIPPLE，这是一个用于可执行工作流合成的合成留出基准。RIPPLE将验证成功率提高最多23.1%，并在两个额外的冻结语言模型骨干上产生正向增益，同时保持编辑效率和低执行成本。针对性的交互分析进一步展示了这两个特性：片段局部的工具使用编辑改变了下游……
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提出的策略编辑局部性与组合安全性分析框架，对多智能体工作流合成具有方法学意义，但其应用场景为通用工作流合成，未涉及地理空间任务，与GIS研究的直接关联有限。

papers.title: Look Before You Leap: Pre-Action Verification for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 三思而后行：LLM智能体的动作前验证
papers.reason: 该文研究LLM智能体动作执行前的确定性验证，与LLM和多智能体研究方向相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市应用。
papers.abstract: An LLM agent acts on the world by emitting actions: shell commands to run, edits to apply. A wrong action does not always fail loudly; it can fail silently, producing a plausible but incorrect effect that raises no error. We argue that a cheap deterministic check, run before an action takes effect, is an effective and underused form of agent oversight, and we study it across two action modalities in one framework. The idea is to fix an action's correct effect by construction, before any executor runs, so that silent failure is measured directly and the verifier may abstain rather than guess. For shell commands, a static verifier over 9930 commands and 482 tools catches 95.8% of invalid commands at a 10.0% false-positive rate. Its syntax and binary checks are oracle-exact, giving zero false positives while catching half of all errors; the flag check is bounded only by help-text coverage and accounts for every false positive. For code edits, a benchmark of 640 edits over 224 files isolating the apply step exposes a sharp split. Content-anchored formats such as search/replace and diff fail cleanly, whereas location-anchored formats fail silently: line numbers corrupt 99.1% of files under a one-line shift, and function-name edits hit the wrong function 12.7% of the time. In both settings a refuse-when-unsure policy turns silent failures into recoverable ones at a tunable cost in applicability: selective grounding reaches 0.958 recall at 7.0% false positives, and an anchor-and-verify applier records one silent misapplication in 8320 trials (0.01%). We release both benchmarks, the verifiers, and the guards.
papers.summary_zh: LLM智能体通过发出动作（如运行shell命令、应用编辑）来作用于世界。错误的动作并不总是大声失败；它可能静默失败，产生看似合理但错误的效果而不引发错误。作者认为，在动作生效前运行廉价的确定性检查是一种有效但未被充分利用的智能体监督形式，并在一个框架中跨两种动作模态进行研究。其思路是在任何执行器运行之前通过构造固定动作的正确效果，从而直接测量静默失败，且验证器可以弃权而非猜测。对于shell命令，一个静态验证器在9930条命令和482个工具上以10.0%的假阳性率捕获95.8%的无效命令。其语法和二进制检查是预言精确的，在捕获一半错误的同时实现零假阳性；标志检查仅受帮助文本覆盖范围限制，并解释了所有假阳性。对于代码编辑，一个包含224个文件上640次编辑的基准测试隔离了应用步骤，暴露出明显的分化。内容锚定格式（如搜索/替换和diff）干净地失败，而位置锚定格式则静默失败：行号在单行偏移下损坏99.1%的文件，函数名编辑有12.7%的概率命中错误函数。在两种设置中，不确定时拒绝的策略将静默失败转化为可恢复失败，代价是可适用性的可调成本：选择性接地达到0.958召回率和7.0%假阳性，锚定并验证的应用器在8320次试验中仅记录一次静默误应用（0.01%）。作者发布了两个基准、验证器和防护措施。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究为LLM智能体在GIS工作流中的可靠部署提供了动作前验证思路，可能减少空间分析自动化中的静默错误，但需针对地理空间操作（如坐标变换、空间查询）进行适配。
